title: Gem of undying
description: Better totem of totem of undying, changes the totem of undying into a cool gem.
body:
# 💎 Gem of Undying

Replaces the **Totem of Undying** with a stylish **pink gem** for a cleaner, more modern look.

## ✨ Features
* 💎 Turns the Totem of Undying into a pink gem
* 🎨 Sleek, minimal redesign
* ⚔️ Keeps the original function unchanged
* 🚀 Lightweight and performance-friendly
